# Campaign explainer in English and Bulgarian

One explainer, two locales: an English project and a Bulgarian project with their own locale-bound claims, rendered by HyperFrames in Geist (which covers Cyrillic) and joined with a sliding language switch.

- Type: Multilingual explainer (EN + BG)
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 12 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/05-multilingual-explainer.mp4`](../videos/05-multilingual-explainer.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-variants skill to make a 12-second 16:9 explainer for Magnifito that shows how a campaign comes together: plan, create, launch, measure. Play it in English first, then in Bulgarian ("Как протича една кампания" / "План, създаване, старт, анализ"). Keep one project per locale with its own claims register so each claim matches its locale, use Geist from fonts/ for both because it has Cyrillic glyphs, and show the four steps as an icon row. Render both locales transparent with HyperFrames and composite them over the Magnifito cream backdrop, with the English card sliding out and the Bulgarian card sliding in at the switch.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- 05-multilingual-explainer
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/05-multilingual-explainer/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render en --codec mov_prores --force
mgvideo render bg --codec mov_prores --force
node collect-run.mjs en/runs work/text-en.mov
node collect-run.mjs bg/runs work/text-bg.mov
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=320x180:r=30:d=12,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.28*W+0.10*W*sin(T*0.5)),2)+pow(Y-(0.80*H+0.10*H*cos(T*0.4)),2))/(2*pow(0.26*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=320x180:r=30:d=12,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.80*W+0.08*W*cos(T*0.35)),2)+pow(Y-(0.18*H+0.08*H*sin(T*0.45)),2))/(2*pow(0.30*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=0xf0eadf:s=320x180:r=30:d=12" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=1920x1080:r=30:d=0.04" -filter_complex "[0]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.11:gg=0.15:bb=0.18[g1];[1]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.05:gg=0.07:bb=0.08[g2];[2]format=gbrp[base];[base][g1]blend=all_mode=subtract[m];[m][g2]blend=all_mode=subtract,scale=1920:1080:flags=bicubic[soft];[3]format=gray,geq=lum='255*clip(1.9-hypot(mod(X,40)-20,mod(Y,40)-20),0,1)',loop=loop=-1:size=1,trim=duration=12,setpts=N/30/TB,format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.16:gg=0.2:bb=0.22[dots];[soft][dots]blend=all_mode=subtract,noise=alls=2:allf=t,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 12 -c:v libx264 -crf 12 -preset veryfast work/bg.mp4
ffmpeg -i work/bg.mp4 -i work/text-en.mov -i work/text-bg.mov -filter_complex "[1]format=yuva420p,split=2[e0][e1];[2]format=yuva420p,setpts=PTS+6/TB,split=2[g0][g1];[e0]trim=start=0:end=2.5,fade=t=in:st=0.15:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=2.15:d=0.35:alpha=1[t0];[e1]trim=start=2.5:end=6,fade=t=in:st=2.55:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=5.6:d=0.4:alpha=1[t1];[g0]trim=start=6:end=8.5,fade=t=in:st=6:d=0.5:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=8.15:d=0.35:alpha=1[t2];[g1]trim=start=8.5:end=12,fade=t=in:st=8.55:d=0.7:alpha=1[t3];[0][t0]overlay=y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-0.15)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v0];[v0][t1]overlay=x='-320*pow(max(0,(t-5.55)/0.45),2)':y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-2.55)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v1];[v1][t2]overlay=x='320*pow(max(0,1-(t-6)/0.8),3)':eof_action=pass[v2];[v2][t3]overlay=y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-8.55)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v3];[v3]fade=t=in:d=0.4,fade=t=out:st=11.4:d=0.6,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 12 -an -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p work/explainer-en-bg.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/explainer-en-bg.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
